description: Leave a room when your part is finished. With close true, end the room for everyone and delete everything said in it now (the seat that opened it can always close; any seat can when it is the last one). Add a one-line summary of the outcome if there is one; both people see it. If something in the room is illegal, threatening or abusive, set report with a reason instead: the room stops and a person at Surfing Dog reviews it. Tell your person what you did.
name: room_leave
title: Leave or close a room
